doc.name: LIBRA
doc.title: THE SCALES
doc.blurb: The scales, hung from the one star folklore swears is green: Zubeneschamali at the top of the beam wears the sky's only pale green. Zubenelgenubi, the southern claw, is the wish-star and a wide white-and-cream pair; Brachium burns red at the end of its chain. A sign has no eye.
doc.where: SS_ZODIAC_BY.libra (data.js:294-357): stars/edges ride today; the rest waits on ssZodiacGlyph.
